# flock

> Privacy-preserving location coordination for trusted adult circles (18+, never
> for tracking children) over Nostr. Location sharing is off by default; while
> sharing, each sender chooses region-to-exact precision. The library also
> carries parked coercion-resistant safety modules that can disclose on a local
> breach/pick-up/help trigger; the app UI does not use them. A thin application
> layer over `canary-kit` (which extends `spoken-token`): the library decides
> policy and builds inner events; the app encodes geohashes, signs, encrypts,
> gift-wraps per recipient, and publishes outer kind-1059 events.

Facts an assistant needs before recommending or generating code:

- **Private repo** (`forgesworn/flock`), MIT licence. This repo is the app
  (`flock-app`), not the library. The `@forgesworn/flock` package is **not
  published to npm** (`"private": true`); its source lives in
  `forgesworn/flock-kit`, and this repo pins it by full commit SHA via git+ssh.
  There is no local `src/` alias. ESM-only, Node ≥ 24, British English
  throughout.
- **Shipped app surface:** multiple trusted-adult circles; ongoing/today/custom
  lifetimes; QR/link/six-word/remote-signer invites; default-off live sharing
  with geohash precision 3–9; map, encrypted group chat and DMs; roll-call and
  direct quick actions; temporary exact festival mode; lost/ring/consent-gated
  exact find; droppable map pins (drag-to-aim, icon picker, remove-by-anyone);
  foreground radar with BLE proximity assist; backup/reseed/remove/disband;
  offline PMTiles; Tor/onion routing; App Lock and decoy view; local or
  external signing.
- **Android native:** background fix→policy→encrypt→gift-wrap→relay publish is
  shipped in Kotlin and hardware-verified while locked/walking and in stationary
  deep Doze on GrapheneOS. **Stay reachable** keeps a persistent Nostr relay
  path for app-closed inbound alerts; it defaults on once a real identity
  exists (a fresh/decoy install stays off) and can be turned off. This is not
  UnifiedPush. The native locked-phone radar guide is built/JVM-vector-tested
  but still needs its field pass; the live GrapheneOS/Orbot beacon pass is
  also pending.
- **Library-only/parked from the app UI:** geofence breach, SOS/duress,
  dead-man's-switch check-ins, breadcrumb trail, no-report zones,
  rendezvous/fair meeting point, off-grid, and spoken pickup verification.
- **iOS:** foreground PWA only; there is no native iOS background path.
- **Every signal is NIP-59 gift-wrapped**: this is unconditional, not a
  setting or a per-mode option.

## Privacy invariants (never break these: FLOCK.md §6)

1. Withholding location must be observationally identical to sharing.
2. A duress trigger must look identical to normal use; duress vocabulary is
   generative, never a fixed list.
3. Beacon and duress payloads use distinct derived keys, never shared.
4. Geofence membership is evaluated on-device; raw coordinates never leave the
   device except as an encrypted beacon after a triggering event, or while the
   user is actively sharing, as encrypted beacons at their chosen precision.

## Library modules (`@forgesworn/flock`, source in flock-kit): pure, framework-free, no I/O

Each is importable as a subpath (`@forgesworn/flock/<module>`); the root import
re-exports all of them plus the full `canary-kit` + `canary-kit/nostr` surface.

- `geofence`: circle/polygon fences, `isBreach` (single fence), accuracy-aware
  containment. Multi-fence helpers live in `policy`.
- `policy`: the disclosure-on-event decision (`decideEmission`); precedence
  `help > pickup > breach > night-out coarse > withhold`. `mode: 'family'` is
  library-only/legacy: the app's `decideEmission` calls all use `'nightout'`.
- `signals`: `beacon`/`breach`/`pickup` + `help` duress → unsigned kind-20078
  events; builders derive keys and encrypt internally from the group seed.
- `nightout`: ephemeral groups (NIP-40 expiry), presence (derived: a member is
  "gone home" when their beacons go stale, default 600 s), separation outliers.
- `checkin`: dead-man's-switch: encrypted "I'm OK" heartbeats (any cadence),
  `ok`/`overdue`/`missed` classifier, local self-reminders (`selfCheckInStatus`),
  and "I've got this" acknowledgement + escalation (`buildAckSignal`,
  `classifyEscalation`) so a miss is handled by a person, not a single toast.
- `trail`: pre-SOS breadcrumbs: on-device rolling buffer (`pushCrumb`),
  disclosed only with a help/breach as a duress-keyed `trail` signal; no-report
  zones excluded at record time.
- `noreport`: inverse fences that cap disclosure over sensitive addresses.
- `buzz`: encrypted "look at your phone" ping. `allclear`: stand-down with a
  coerced flag. `fences`: circle-wide safe-place sync (latest-wins).
- `rendezvous`: "be back by / meet at" with ETA + at-risk assessment.
- `meeting`: fair meeting-point request/share. `disband`: circle dissolution.
- `offgrid`: deliberate "going dark" pre-announcement. `spokenverify`:
  face-to-face pick-up verification words + silent duress word.
- `joined`: encrypted member-joined notice. `lost`: lost-device flag and
  ring request. `findping`: remote exact-ping request whose consent gates live
  on the receiving device. `radar`: pure distance/bearing/freshness/uncertainty
  guidance and cue rules shared with the native implementation.

## API quick reference (exact signatures)

```ts
// geofence
isBreach(point: LatLng, fence: Geofence): boolean            // ONE fence
type Geofence = { kind: 'circle', centre: LatLng, radiusMetres: number }
              | { kind: 'polygon', vertices: LatLng[] }       // LatLng = { lat, lon }

// policy (multi-fence helpers live here, not in geofence)
isWithinAnyFence(point: LatLng, fences: Geofence[]): boolean
decideEmission(ctx: EmissionContext, precisions?: Partial<EmissionPrecisions>): EmissionPlan
// EmissionContext: { mode: 'family'|'nightout' /* 'family' is library-only/legacy */, position?: LatLng|null,
//   geofences?: Geofence[], trigger?: 'none'|'pickup'|'help', accuracyMetres?: number,
//   offGrid?: boolean, noReportZones?: NoReportZone[] }
// EmissionPlan: { action: 'withhold'|'coarse'|'full', precision: number /* 0 when withholding */,
//   reason: 'none'|'nightout'|'breach'|'pickup'|'help' }

// signals: async; encryption + key derivation happen inside the builder
buildLocationSignal(p: { groupId: string, seedHex: string, signalType: 'beacon'|'breach'|'pickup',
  geohash: string, precision: number }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>
buildHelpSignal(p: { groupId: string, seedHex: string, member: string,
  location: { geohash: string, precision: number, locationSource: 'beacon'|'verifier' } | null,
  scope?: 'group'|'persona'|'master', originGroupId?: string }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>
signalTypeForReason(reason: EmissionReason): SignalType | null

// nightout: presence is DERIVED from beacon staleness; there is no "mark gone home" setter
nightOutExpiry(startedAt: number, durationSeconds: number): number
buildNightOutGroupEvent(p: { groupId: string, members: string[], encryptedContent: string,
  startedAt: number, durationSeconds: number, rotationInterval?: number, tolerance?: number }): UnsignedEvent
classifyPresence(beacons: MemberBeacon[], now: number, opts?: { staleAfterSeconds?: number }): PresenceEntry[]
stillOut(entries: PresenceEntry[]): PresenceEntry[]

// checkin
buildCheckInSignal(p: { groupId: string, seedHex: string, member: string,
  intervalSeconds: number, timestamp?: number,
  battery?: 'low'|'critical' }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>  // interval <= 0 stands down
classifyCheckins(checkins: CheckIn[], now: number, opts?: { graceSeconds?: number }): CheckInState[]
selfCheckInStatus(mine: CheckIn | null, now: number, opts?: { remindBeforeSeconds?: number,
  graceSeconds?: number }): 'none'|'ok'|'due-soon'|'overdue'|'missed'  // LOCAL only, never emits
buildAckSignal(p: { groupId: string, seedHex: string, member: string, target: string,
  timestamp?: number }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>  // "I've got this" for target's missed check-in
classifyEscalation(states: CheckInState[], acks: CheckInAck[], now: number,
  opts?: { stepSeconds?: number }): EscalationState[]  // unacknowledged first, levels 0-2

// trail: buffer is memory-only; disclosure only rides a help/breach
pushCrumb(crumbs: Breadcrumb[], crumb: Breadcrumb, opts?: { maxCrumbs?: number,
  maxAgeSeconds?: number, minSpacingSeconds?: number }): Breadcrumb[]  // pure; skips too-soon/older crumbs
buildTrailSignal(p: { groupId: string, seedHex: string, member: string,
  reason: 'help'|'breach', crumbs: Breadcrumb[], timestamp?: number }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>  // DURESS key
// Breadcrumb = { geohash: string, precision: number, timestamp: number }

// radar: pure guidance and cue rules, shared with the native locked-phone radar guide
radarGuidance(input: RadarInput, opts?: RadarOptions): RadarGuidance
// RadarInput: { me: LatLng|null, headingDeg: number|null, target: TargetObservation|null,
//   myAccuracyMetres?: number|null }
// TargetObservation: { position: LatLng, uncertaintyMetres: number, ageSeconds: number }
// RadarGuidance: { state: 'unavailable'|'no-fix'|'stale'|'coarse'|'arrived'|'no-heading'|'point',
//   distanceMetres, bearingDeg, relativeBearingDeg: number|null, freshness: Freshness|null,
//   alignment: 'aligned'|'near'|'off'|null, bearingUsable: boolean,
//   uncertaintyMetres: number|null, myAccuracyMetres: number|null }
cueFor(g: RadarGuidance, ctx?: { mode?: 'vector'|'seek'|'homing', closingRateMps?: number|null,
  bleProximity?: 'immediate'|'near'|'far'|null }, opts?: RadarOptions): RadarCue
// RadarCue: { pattern: 'silent'|'sparse'|'single'|'double'|'triple', periodMs: number,
//   toneHz: number, vibrateMs: number[], pan: number, sign: 'left'|'right'|null,
//   trend: 'closing'|'receding'|null }
classifyFreshness(ageSeconds: number, opts?: RadarOptions): 'fresh'|'aging'|'stale'
// RADAR defaults: freshSeconds 60, staleSeconds 600, arriveMetres 2

// lost: LOST_SIGNAL_TYPE = 'lost'
buildLostSignal(p: { groupId: string, seedHex: string, member: string, by: string, lost: boolean,
  timestamp?: number, message?: string }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>
decryptLost(seedHex: string, content: string): Promise<LostReport>
// LostReport = { member: string, by: string, lost: boolean, timestamp: number, message?: string }

// findping: FIND_PING_SIGNAL_TYPE = 'findreq'; consent is gated on the receiving device
buildFindPingSignal(p: { groupId: string, seedHex: string, from: string, target: string,
  timestamp?: number }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>
decryptFindPing(seedHex: string, content: string): Promise<FindPing>
// FindPing = { from: string, target: string, timestamp: number }

// buzz: BUZZ_SIGNAL_TYPE = 'buzz'
buildBuzzSignal(p: { groupId: string, seedHex: string, from: string, action: BuzzAction,
  target?: string, timestamp?: number }): Promise<UnsignedEvent>
decryptBuzz(seedHex: string, content: string): Promise<Buzz>
// BuzzAction = 'check_in'|'on_my_way'|'ring_lost_phone'
// Buzz = { from: string, action: BuzzAction, reason: string, target?: string,
//   timestamp: number, ask?: 'location' }

// other modules: see flock-kit
```

Geohash encoding is the caller's job (`geohash-kit`'s `encode(lat, lon, precision)`);
signing is the caller's job (e.g. `nostr-tools` `finalizeEvent`). Group creation
(`createGroup`, `buildGroupStateEvent`) comes from `canary-kit`, re-exported at
the root.

End to end, as the app does it for a live-sharing beacon (decide, encode,
build, gift-wrap, publish). `finalizeEvent` sits inside the `Signer`: the inner
signal stays unsigned (a NIP-59 rumour), and `giftWrap` signs the seal:

```ts
import { encode } from 'geohash-kit'
import { finalizeEvent, generateSecretKey, getPublicKey, nip44 } from 'nostr-tools'
import { deriveInbox } from '@forgesworn/covey-kit'
import { giftWrap, publishSigned, type Signer } from '@forgesworn/roost-kit'
import { decideEmission } from '@forgesworn/flock/policy'
import { buildLocationSignal, signalTypeForReason } from '@forgesworn/flock/signals'

const sk = generateSecretKey()
const signer: Signer = {
  pubkey: getPublicKey(sk),
  signEvent: async (t) => finalizeEvent({ ...t, created_at: t.created_at ?? Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) }, sk),
  nip44Encrypt: async (peer, text) => nip44.encrypt(text, nip44.getConversationKey(sk, peer)),
  nip44Decrypt: async (peer, text) => nip44.decrypt(text, nip44.getConversationKey(sk, peer)),
}
const groupId = 'demo-circle'
const seedHex = 'a'.repeat(64) // from canary-kit's createGroup
const fix = { lat: 51.5074, lon: -0.1278 }

const plan = decideEmission({ mode: 'nightout', position: fix, trigger: 'none' }, { coarse: 6 })
const type = signalTypeForReason(plan.reason) // 'nightout' -> 'beacon'
if (plan.action !== 'withhold' && type && type !== 'help') {
  const inner = await buildLocationSignal({
    groupId, seedHex, signalType: type,
    geohash: encode(fix.lat, fix.lon, plan.precision), precision: plan.precision, // caller encodes
  })
  const wrap = await giftWrap(signer, deriveInbox(seedHex).pk, inner) // unsigned inner -> kind 1059
  await publishSigned(['wss://relay.example'], { ...wrap })
}
```

`examples/quickstart.ts` tours the wider library modules (geofence, help,
night-out, check-in) and runs with `node examples/quickstart.ts` on Node ≥ 24.

**Gift-wrapping is mandatory before publish** (FLOCK.md §3.3): the library has
no wrap helper; the PWA wraps every signal via `@forgesworn/roost-kit`
(`giftWrap(signer, recipientPk, inner, routeTag?)` → signed kind-1059, NIP-40
expiry baked in); an external consumer can use `nostr-tools`'s `nip59` module.
Publishing an unwrapped signal violates the privacy model.

## Conventions

British English. ESM-only, ES2022. TDD: failing test first. Library modules
stay pure (return new state, no mutation). Geohash encoding + encryption stay
at the edge. Commits: `type: description`, no Co-Authored-By lines.
NIP-44 encryption (never NIP-04); NIP-40 `expiration` tag (never `expiry`).
